items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).

items.source: id - An identifier for the response.
items.translation: id - 响应的标识符。

items.source: embeddings - An array of embeddings, where each embedding is an array of floats with 1024 elements. The length of the embeddings array will be the same as the length of the original texts array.
items.translation: embeddings - 一个嵌入数组，其中每个嵌入是一个包含 1024 个浮点数的数组。嵌入数组的长度将与原始文本数组的长度相同。

items.source: texts - An array containing the text entries for which embeddings were returned.
items.translation: texts - 包含返回嵌入的文本条目的数组。

items.source: responseType - The type of the response. The value is always embeddings.
items.translation: responseType - 响应的类型。该值始终为 embeddings。

items.source: amazonBedrockInvocationMetrics - Bedrock invocation metrics. Currently bedrock doesn't return invocationMetrics for the cohere embedding model.
